# Keybindings

> Every default keyboard shortcut the *Label Studio — Labels, Barcodes & Data* extension contributes, with the command it runs and when it is active, generated from `package.json` `contributes.keybindings`.

| Key | macOS | Command | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ctrl+k v` | `cmd+k v` | Label: Open Label Preview to the Side (`labelStudio.previewToSide`) | `editorLangId == zpl \|\| editorLangId == epl` |
| `ctrl+k l` | `cmd+k l` | Label: Label Actions… (`labelStudio.showActions`) | `editorLangId == zpl \|\| editorLangId == epl` |
